scaling: z-score, fitted on the fit slice only
threshold_rule: numpy.quantile(fit-slice scores, q), method 'linear'; alert if score > threshold
note: Descriptive and label-free; after freeze-v1, not part of the frozen evaluation. ULB is development data for the stress test.

runs.L2a: random 50% of day 1 -> other 50% of day 1
runs.L2b: day 1, first 12 h -> day 1, last 12 h

r: alert rate on the scored slice / (1 - q); mean over IForest seeds, r_min and r_max over seeds
